eval_depth: evaluate predicted depth against ground truth depth tensors and return MSE, RMSE, and absolute error metrics
eval_pose: evaluate predicted camera poses against ground truth poses computing center and angle errors with optional alignment
eval_point_cloud: construct and compare predicted and ground truth point clouds using pose, depth, and intrinsics to compute alignment errors
eval_pth: evaluate a single ScanNet split .pth file by running pose, depth, and point cloud evaluation and optionally dumping results to JSON
eval_scannet: run full ScanNet evaluation over a directory of split files using a SLAM function handle and print averaged results
